players.product: HPC / AI data-center campuses on secured power for lease (Panther Creek PA 350 MW, Sharon PA, Moses Lake WA 18 MW, Sherbrooke QC 96 MW; RFS 2027) - converted from Bitcoin mining

quarterly_data.signal: Keel's 10-Q: it ceased Bitcoin mining at its Washington State site on April 28, 2026 and began converting it to an 18 gross MW HPC data center, and ceased mining at Panther Creek, Scrubgrass and Sharon on June 29, 2026. Panther Creek and Scrubgrass (approximately 60 gross MW and 63 gross MW energized, not yet under an electric supply agreement) keep selling energy while being developed for HPC; the 110 gross MW Sharon site is planned for conversion to an HPC data center. As of August 7, 2026 no HPC data center operations had commenced and no related revenue was recognized. Total Pipeline was 2,161 gross MW at June 30, 2026 versus 561 a year earlier (Secured Data Center Capacity 648 versus 561). Equipment and construction prepayments rose to $71,885 (in thousands) from $20,164 at December 31, 2025, driven by HPC development.
quarterly_data.figure: Total pipeline 2,161 gross MW (vs 561); equipment and construction prepayments $71,885 thousand
